integrity: The cyclic defining set is reconstructed exactly, the generator polynomial is derived in F16 and checked against all defining zeros, all 64 codewords are enumerated, self-orthogonality is checked directly, and the projective-complement description and all 21 two-dimensional message subspaces are independently verified.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to the self-orthogonal cyclic [15,3,11]_4 code in Example 4.16. It does not classify all optimal quaternary [15,3,11] codes or determine the full automorphism group.
title: Projective geometry of the optimal quaternary code in Example 4.16
